name: Dumbbell Alternating Renegade Row
instructions: Place two dumbbells on the floor about shoulder width apart. Grip the handles and take a high-plank position on your toes, with your body straight from head to heels.
If your hips rotate or your lower back sags, widen your feet or use lighter dumbbells. Press one dumbbell firmly into the floor to support your body.
Row the other dumbbell toward your side by pulling your elbow back. Keep your working shoulder blade pulled toward your spine.
Lower the dumbbell to the floor with control, then row the dumbbell in your other hand. Keep your hips square to the floor throughout the movement.
Do 6-12 repetitions on each side. Stop if you feel sharp pain in your shoulders, wrists, or lower back.
